# Vendored dependencies

- Lenis 1.3.26 — https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis
- Distribution: https://unpkg.com/lenis@1.3.26/dist/lenis.min.js
- License: MIT, reproduced in LENIS-LICENSE.txt.

Served locally; no CDN request at runtime. Used for desktop wheel easing across the marketing site. Touch, reduced-motion preferences, keyboard controls, and ordinary browser history remain native.
